# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 24 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 24:4 — tablets of stone and clay — preservation strategy

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "tablets of stone and on tablets of clay" | Literal in tabulis lapideis et in tabulis luteis |
| LOGOS | "tablets of stone and on tablets of clay" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "tablets of stone and on tablets of clay" | Same |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** All agree. The dual-tablet preservation strategy is a key textual motif. No divergence.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of All.
